body:
Background: I'm not a stranger to Codeine or Oxy. I initially got both of them prescribed to me after a series of hospitalizations due to a kidney problem. Right flank pain is incredibly painful.
Anyways, I cold water extracted from 3 percocets and 3 tylenol 3's. I took them both at about 12:00 at night. (I also took one Benadryl, 25mg as a booster and to reduce any itching... I read it could possibly happen on doses of codeine)
Normally, I'm an extremely depressed person. I've been suffering from suicidal feelings for some time, and especially during the time I took the drug. I needed an escape
Around 12:15 I wasn't feeling anything so I was a little disappointed. But by the time I finished watching the Simpsons, I was feeling it come on hardcore. I was watching Hannah Montana, and even THAT seemed to be funny to me. I felt super nice sitting, and my head felt light on my shoulders and everything felt surprisingly neutral.
I was surfing a suicide forum I usually go to, but tonight I didnt feel suicidal at all. It was one of the greatest feelings in the world.
I guess I watched Disney all night. I wandered off to bed around 2:00, still feeling pleasant. I pulled up my sheets, and it was remarkably soft. I sunk my head down, and it felt absoloutly fantastic and I dozed off.
I sunk my head down, and it felt absoloutly fantastic and I dozed off.
The next morning, I wasn't really groggy, but somewhat down on myself. All my old feelings rebounded, so the trip didn't really change anything but made me feel awesome for a few hours.
All my old feelings rebounded, so the trip didn't really change anything but made me feel awesome for a few hours.
I plan on doing it again next weekend. I wish I could do this all the time, but I've gone through withdrawal with other drugs (Benzos... which wasn't fun) so I decided to not 'self-medicate' all the time with these ones.
